summary: New AI SDK adapters, platform deployment enhancements, security improvements, and AI Gateway model updates, alongside removal of several AI model offers and platform features.

key_changes.title: Chat SDK adds Instagram adapter
key_changes.impact: Enables developers to build Instagram Direct Message bots with media, quick replies, reactions, and story replies, expanding Chat SDK’s reach.
key_changes.explanation: Adds a new adapter for Instagram, broadening the SDK’s supported platforms.

key_changes.title: Vercel for Platforms can now deploy from your users' GitHub repositories
key_changes.impact: Allows platform builders to deploy directly from users’ GitHub repos using short-lived tokens, simplifying onboarding and security.
key_changes.explanation: Introduces a token-based deployment flow that keeps source code secure.

key_changes.title: Sign JWTs from your Functions without managing private keys
key_changes.impact: Improves security for serverless functions by enabling key management via Vercel KMS, removing the need to store private keys in code.
key_changes.explanation: Provides a managed key service for JWT signing in Functions.

key_changes.title: GLM 5.3 now available on AI Gateway
key_changes.impact: Adds a new large language model to the AI Gateway, giving users more options for AI workloads.
key_changes.explanation: Introduces GLM‑5.3 with no markup or platform fee.

key_changes.title: GPT-5.6 Sol is 50% off on AI Gateway for the next month
key_changes.impact: Offers a temporary discount on GPT‑5.6 Sol, encouraging adoption of the model on the AI Gateway.
key_changes.explanation: Provides a 50% price reduction for a limited period.

key_changes.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash discount removed
key_changes.impact: Users lose the 50% discount on Gemini 3.7 Flash, potentially affecting cost-sensitive projects.
key_changes.explanation: The promotional pricing for Gemini 3.7 Flash is no longer available.

key_changes.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro updated weights removed
key_changes.impact: Users no longer receive automatic weight updates for DeepSeek V4 Pro on the AI Gateway.
key_changes.explanation: The feature that auto‑updates weights for DeepSeek V4 Pro has been discontinued.

key_changes.title: One-click upgrade for deprecated Node.js versions removed
key_changes.impact: Deprecated Node.js projects lose the one-click upgrade convenience, requiring manual updates.
key_changes.explanation: The one-click upgrade option for older Node.js versions has been removed.
